epistemic_rules: Scientific anatomy/physiology and Potatoverse symbolism must remain separately typed.
Tim's first attestation and the date of later neuroscience research must remain separate.
One project symbol may have multiple biological neighbors without becoming identical to any of them.
One biological structure may participate in many project metaphors without proving them.
Human evidence, animal evidence, theory and speculation should not be flattened into one confidence level.
Active fields such as glymphatic transport, microbiome causal mechanisms, neuroimmune border biology and consciousness science must remain explicitly updateable.
